name: VITA5
description: Play a PS Vita on the PS5 over one USB cable.
author: StonedModder
release_notes:
Install
This app requires the official VitaUSBStream plugin from BMK-Studio: https://github.com/BMK-Studio/VitaUSBStream

No other USB streaming plugin is supported or will work.

Both devices must already run homebrew. The Vita needs VitaUSBStream. The PS5 needs a jailbreak with elfldr.

This release has three files.

1. Vita plugin
- Copy input_receiver.skprx to ur0:tai/ (VitaShell).
- In ur0:tai/config.txt, under *KERNEL, put this line above VitaUSBStream.skprx:

*KERNEL

ur0:tai/input_receiver.skprx

ur0:tai/VitaUSBStream.skprx
- Reboot the Vita. The input plugin must load before the stream plugin.

2. PS5 dock service
- Make sure the PS5 payload loader is running.
- Send VITA5-payload.elf to elfldr (port 9021).
- Leave it running.

3. PS5 app
- Extract PPSA17035.zip.
- Copy the PPSA17035 folder to /data/homebrew/ over FTP (port 2120).
- Every file and directory in that folder must be mode 0777. If the app will not start, fix the modes first.
- Close any older VITA5 title, then launch PPSA17035 from the home screen.

Connect the Vita to the PS5 with one USB cable. The Vita's picture and sound play on the TV, and the DualSense controls the game.
